name: Open Information Extraction (OIE) Benchmark
description: Provides a large dataset for evaluating open information extraction systems that extract relational tuples from text.
evaluation_method: precision / recall / F1 (often reported as F1)
reputation: A standard benchmark family in the information extraction community with moderate adoption for evaluating OIE systems and model comparisons.
notes: Evaluation is sensitive to annotation style and canonicalization (different gold tuple formats); multiple evaluation scripts/partial-match criteria exist. Datasets can be noisy and heterogeneous across domains. Risk of pretraining contamination exists for large pre-trained LMs.
